summary: The registrant, Redwood Trust, Inc., filed an 8-K to report the completion of a registered public offering of $125 million in 9.75% Senior Notes due 2031, with an underwriters' option for an additional $18.75 million. Net proceeds of ~$120.41 million (or ~$138.57 million if overallotment exercised) will be used for general corporate purposes, including funding mortgage banking platforms and strategic acquisitions. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
